article.title: Penny Trickle | My AWS Cost Reduction
article.description: I almost had to reduce my beer budget, but then, I remembered all the talk about AWS Optimization and how AWS is helping customers save cost. With a closer look at available options, I was able to reduce my cost of using AWS for webhosting by ~92%.
article.author: Frank Manu
article.bodyMarker: reduce my cost of using AWS for webhosting by ~92%.
